title: Усилители и смягчители: quite, rather, fairly, utterly, somewhat

why: Слова вроде quite, rather, fairly, utterly, somewhat регулируют «громкость» прилагательного: делают признак слабее или сильнее. В русском мы обходимся «очень», «довольно», «совершенно», а в английском выбор точного слова показывает уровень языка.
formation: • Смягчители (слабее): a bit, a little, slightly, somewhat, fairly, reasonably, kind of
• Усилители для крайних прилагательных: absolutely, utterly, completely, totally (absolutely fantastic, utterly ridiculous)

• Порядок слов: quite / rather + a + прилагательное + существительное (quite a good idea, rather a long day), но a + fairly / pretty / rather + прилагательное + существительное (a fairly good idea, a rather long day).
usage: 1. Обычные (градуируемые) прилагательные: tired, big, good, difficult. Они сочетаются с very, extremely, quite, fairly, a bit. (It's very difficult. — Это очень сложно.)
2. Крайние (неградуируемые) прилагательные: exhausted, huge, terrible, impossible, fantastic. С ними нужны absolutely, utterly, completely. (It's absolutely impossible. — Это абсолютно невозможно.)

3. fairly обычно с положительным смыслом (fairly good — неплохой), rather чаще с отрицательным или неожиданным (rather expensive — дороговато). (The hotel was rather noisy. — Отель оказался довольно шумным.)
4. somewhat — формальное «в некоторой степени». (We were somewhat surprised. — Мы были несколько удивлены.)
5. Смягчение критики: not entirely sure, a bit worried, slightly disappointed звучат вежливее, чем прямое «I'm worried».
signalWords: В отзывах, деловой переписке и рабочих обсуждениях: rather, somewhat, slightly (смягчить), absolutely, utterly, totally (усилить).
mistakes: ✗ very excellent → ✓ absolutely excellent (excellent уже «крайнее», very с ним не идёт)
✗ absolutely tired → ✓ very tired / extremely tired (tired обычное, absolutely с ним не сочетается)
✗ a quite good idea → ✓ quite a good idea (quite стоит перед a)
✗ I very like it → ✓ I like it very much (very не стоит перед глаголом)
✗ She was much tired → ✓ She was very tired (much с прилагательными не используется)
remember: Обычное прилагательное берёт very, крайнее берёт absolutely, а quite и rather ставь перед a.

exercises.instruction: Выберите правильный усилитель: very или absolutely / utterly / completely

items.prompt: The view from the hotel was ___ breathtaking. (a) very (b) absolutely
items.answer: absolutely

items.prompt: I'm ___ tired after the flight. (a) very (b) absolutely
items.answer: very

items.prompt: The test was ___ difficult, but I passed. (a) very (b) utterly
items.answer: very

items.prompt: His excuse was ___ ridiculous. (a) very (b) utterly
items.answer: utterly

items.prompt: She is ___ famous in our city. (a) very (b) completely
items.answer: very

items.prompt: It's ___ impossible to finish by Friday. (a) very (b) absolutely
items.answer: absolutely

items.prompt: The soup is ___ hot. Be careful. (a) very (b) absolutely
items.answer: very

items.prompt: We were ___ terrified during the storm. (a) very (b) absolutely
items.answer: absolutely

exercises.instruction: Добавьте слово из скобок в правильное место

items.answer: It was quite a good idea.
She is a rather talented designer. / She is rather a talented designer.
He is a fairly interesting speaker.
We had a rather long meeting. / We had rather a long meeting.
That was quite a nice surprise.
It's a pretty big problem.
The code is reasonably clean.
It was a somewhat difficult decision.

exercises.instruction: Смягчите высказывание с помощью слова в скобках

items.answer: The price is a bit high.
I'm slightly disappointed.
The deadline is somewhat tight.
The room is a little cold.
I'm not entirely sure.
I don't completely agree with you. / I'm not completely in agreement with you.
The layout is rather confusing.

items.prompt: I'm worried about the budget. (a bit)
items.answer: I'm a bit worried about the budget.

items.prompt: It was a very excellent presentation.
items.answer: It was an absolutely excellent presentation. / It was a really excellent presentation. / It was an excellent presentation.
I'm very tired. / I'm extremely tired. / I'm really tired.

items.prompt: She is a quite good developer.
items.answer: She is quite a good developer.
The task is absolutely impossible. / The task is completely impossible. / The task is utterly impossible.
I like this song very much. / I really like this song.
I completely agree with you. / I totally agree with you. / I absolutely agree with you.
She was very tired. / She was really tired.
The film was very good. / The film was really good.
It was quite a long meeting. / It was a rather long meeting. / It was a pretty long meeting.

items.prompt: Я абсолютно уверен, что это баг.
items.answer: I'm absolutely sure it's a bug. / I'm absolutely sure that it's a bug. / I'm completely sure it's a bug.
It's absolutely impossible. / It's completely impossible. / It's utterly impossible.
I'm a bit tired. / I'm a little tired. / I'm slightly tired.
She speaks English fairly well. / She speaks English quite well. / She speaks English pretty well.
The hotel was absolutely terrible. / The hotel was utterly terrible. / The hotel was absolutely awful. / The hotel was utterly awful.
I'm not entirely sure. / I'm not quite sure. / I'm not completely sure.
We were somewhat surprised by the result. / We were somewhat surprised at the result.
